title: Dicke superradiance in degenerate quantum matter: interplay of exchange statistics and spatial confinement
summary: Collective radiance effects in quantum degenerate systems, such as superradiance and subradiance of a partially inverted ensemble, are shaped by the interplay of spatial confinement and exchange statistics. We investigate this interplay using a purely dissipative field theoretic quartic Lindblad master equation, which captures the nonlinear dynamics of the combined motional and electronic manifolds.
